0x6d832d8e.notice: Verifies a Groth16 proof against `vk` for the given public `input`.
0x6d832d8e.dev: Returns `false` (does not revert) for an invalid proof, an out-of-range public input (`>= SNARK_SCALAR_FIELD`), an off-curve / out-of-range proof point, or a failed pairing. Reverts only on structural misuse (key/input arity mismatch).

params.input: The public inputs, in the circuit's public-signal order.
params.vk: The verifying key for the circuit. MUST be a key the consumer pins (see KEY PINNING above), never one taken from an untrusted caller.

natspec.notice: Stateless Diamond facet exposing a GENERIC Groth16 verifier over BN254. The verifying key is a parameter, so one deployment verifies proofs for any circuit — the primitive the ZK privacy modules plug their circuit's key into.
natspec.dev: All logic lives in {Groth16VerifierLib}. Pure verification (view): no state beyond the ERC-165 registration written at init. The facet does not authenticate the key it is given: consumers MUST pin it (see KEY PINNING on {IGroth16Verifier}).
